<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover"/>
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes"/>
<meta name="theme-color" content="#05050a"/>
<meta name="description" content="Seeker Strike — Genesis Protocol : shoot'em up spatial pour Solana Seeker."/>
<meta property="og:title" content="Seeker Strike — Genesis Protocol"/>
<meta property="og:description" content="Shoot'em up spatial mobile-first pour Solana Seeker."/>
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,"/>
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="assets/inline/icone180.png"/>
<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes"/>
<!-- Verrouillage portrait : ces trois metas sont lues par les WebViews Android
     (AOSP, X5/UC) qui ignorent screen.orientation.lock(). -->
<meta name="screen-orientation" content="portrait"/>
<meta name="x5-orientation" content="portrait"/>
<meta name="full-screen" content="yes"/>
<link rel="manifest" href="data:application/manifest+json;base64,"/>
<title>Seeker Strike • Genesis Protocol v4.4</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Orbitron:wght@600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--p:#9945FF;--g:#14F195;--bg:#05050a}
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;margin:0;padding:0}
html,body{height:100%;background:var(--bg);color:#fff !important;font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;overflow:hidden;overscroll-behavior:none}
/* Le defilement vertical reste possible sur les ecrans de contenu ;
   seul le canvas de jeu capte l'integralite des gestes. */
.screen{touch-action:pan-y}
.screen.game{touch-action:none}
body{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 0%,rgba(153,69,255,.22) 0%,transparent 50%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 90% 100%,rgba(20,241,149,.1) 0%,transparent 45%),#05050a}
button,a{color:#fff;font-family:inherit}
.font-o{font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif}
.glass{background:rgba(14,14,26,.95) !important;backdrop-filter:blur(18px);border:1px solid rgba(153,69,255,.3);box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.45);color:#fff !important}
.btn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#9945FF,#7c3aed 45%,#14F195) !important;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(153,69,255,.45);transition:transform .2s;border:none !important;color:#fff !important;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700}
.btn:active{transform:scale(.96)}
button.glass{color:#fff !important;background:rgba(14,14,26,.95) !important}
.screen button{color:#fff !important}
#air-badge{color:#000 !important}
#s-map{padding:0 !important;overflow:hidden !important}
#s-map.active{display:block !important}
#map-nodes-visual{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:10;pointer-events:auto}
/* Le conteneur qui defile doit faire EXACTEMENT la hauteur visible.
   Avec min-height:100vh il devenait plus haut que la fenetre sur mobile
   (100vh ignore la barre d'URL, pas 100dvh) : son overflow ne se
   declenchait jamais, et body etant en overflow:hidden, plus rien ne
   defilait nulle part. Les deux declarations de hauteur servent de repli
   pour les navigateurs qui ignorent dvh. */
.screen{display:none;height:100vh;height:100dvh;max-height:100dvh;
  overflow-y:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
/* Zone tampon sous le dernier bloc.
   Deux pieges cumules :
   1. le padding-bottom d'un conteneur scrollable est ignore par WebKit
      quand le contenu vit dans un enfant -> il faut une vraie hauteur ;
   2. env(safe-area-inset-bottom) vaut 0 dans la WebView du Seeker alors
      que la barre de gestes Android occupe bien l'espace -> valeur fixe
      genereuse, l'env ne fait que s'ajouter sur les appareils qui le declarent. */
/* ===== Reserve de bas de page =====
   La barre d'onglets flotte au-dessus du contenu (position:fixed, 66 px),
   et la barre de gestes Android en occupe encore une cinquantaine par-dessus.
   Trois pieges se cumulaient :
     1. le padding-bottom pose sur le conteneur scrollable lui-meme est
        ignore par WebKit quand le contenu vit dans un enfant ;
     2. env(safe-area-inset-bottom) vaut 0 dans la WebView du Seeker ;
     3. un spacer injecte en JS peut ne jamais etre pose.
   La reserve porte donc sur l'ENFANT DIRECT, en CSS pur, valeur fixe. */
.screen:not(.game) > div{
  padding-bottom:calc(170px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));
}
/* L'ecran de campagne gere lui-meme sa hauteur : la reserve y creait une
   grande bande noire entre le bas de la carte et la barre d'onglets. */
#s-map > div{ padding-bottom:0 }
/* les couches decoratives en position absolue n'ont rien a reserver */
.screen:not(.game) > div#poussiere,
.screen:not(.game) > div[style*="position:absolute"]{ padding-bottom:0 }

.fin-page{display:block;width:100%;flex:none;pointer-events:none;height:8px}
.screen.active{display:block}
.screen.game{padding-bottom:0;overflow:hidden}
.nav{position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:66px;background:rgba(6,6,14,.97);backdrop-filter:blur(20px);border-top:1px solid rgba(153,69,255,.3);display:flex;justify-content:space-around;align-items:center;z-index:80;padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom)}
.nav.hide{display:none}
/* Accessibilite : focus clavier visible */
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #14F195;outline-offset:2px;border-radius:8px}
button:focus-visible,.nav-i:focus-visible,.tgl:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #14F195;outline-offset:3px}
/* Confort : animations decoratives coupees si l'utilisateur le demande */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
  *,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;
    transition-duration:.01ms!important}
  #splash .fond,.jeu-fond.couche2{animation:none}
  #poussiere{display:none}
}
.nav-i{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:1px;color:#9ca3af;font-size:9px;font-weight:600;padding:4px 6px;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer}
.nav-i.active{color:#14F195}
.nav-i svg{width:20px;height:20px}
/* Boutons retour : SVG plutot que la fleche unicode, qui ne rend pas sur certains WebView */
.screen button svg{vertical-align:middle}
.screen>div>div>button:first-child{min-width:34px;min-height:34px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
/* Icones Recraft : l'etat actif passe par l'opacite et le glow */
.nav-i img{width:22px;height:22px;object-fit:contain;opacity:.42;transition:opacity .2s,filter .2s}
.nav-i.active img{opacity:1;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(20,241,149,.85))}
.ico-stat{width:14px;height:14px;object-fit:contain;vertical-align:-2px;opacity:.9;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(153,69,255,.5))}
.toast{position:fixed;top:14px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-120px);background:rgba(12,12,24,.97);border:1px solid #14F195;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:14px;z-index:300;transition:transform .3s;max-width:92%;text-align:center;font-size:12px;pointer-events:none}
.toast.show{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
.bar{height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);overflow:hidden}
.bar>div{height:100%;border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#9945FF,#14F195);transition:width .35s}
#gc{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;touch-action:none;background:transparent}
.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.88);z-index:200;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:14px}
/* Les contenus longs des modals doivent defiler au doigt */
.modal .overflow-y-auto{touch-action:pan-y;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;overscroll-behavior:contain}

/* ===== En-tetes de section, communs aux ecrans ===== */
.sect{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin:22px 0 11px}
.sect:first-child{margin-top:6px}
.sect .lig{flex:1;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(153,69,255,.45),transparent)}
.sect span{font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:2.5px;color:#9ca3af;white-space:nowrap}

/* ===== Voile de rotation ===== */
/* Palier 90 : theme Genesis. Palier 100 : accents dores. */
.hud-genesis .solde{border-color:rgba(251,191,36,.35);background:rgba(40,30,6,.35)}
.hud-genesis .sect span{color:#fbbf24}
.hud-genesis .bar>div{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fbbf24,#9945FF)}
.rang-validateur .solde u{color:#fbbf24}
/* Palier 150 : la carte prend les couleurs Genesis. */
.rang-architecte #s-map .fond-carte, .rang-architecte #s-map canvas{
  filter:hue-rotate(-18deg) saturate(1.25) brightness(1.06)}
.rang-architecte #badge-validateur{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c4b5fd,#fbbf24)}
#badge-validateur{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:999px;
  font-size:9px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1px;color:#1a1405;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fbbf24,#fde68a);box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(251,191,36,.45)}
#badge-validateur.hidden{display:none}

/* Choix de la langue : premier ecran apres l'accueil, une seule fois. */
#choix-langue{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:600;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  padding:26px;background:rgba(4,3,10,.96);backdrop-filter:blur(7px)}
#choix-langue.on{display:flex}
#choix-langue .boite{width:100%;max-width:330px;text-align:center}
#choix-langue .marque{width:74px;height:74px;margin:0 auto 18px;border-radius:22px;
  background-size:contain;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-position:center}
#choix-langue .tt{font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:2px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#9945FF,#14F195);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;
  -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
#choix-langue .tt2{font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#6b7280;
  margin-top:5px;margin-bottom:22px}
#choix-langue .lg{width:100%;padding:15px 18px;margin-bottom:11px;border-radius:16px;
  border:1px solid rgba(153,69,255,.4);background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);color:#fff;
  text-align:left;cursor:pointer;display:block}
#choix-langue .lg b{display:block;font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:800}
#choix-langue .lg span{display:block;font-size:10.5px;color:#8b8b9e;margin-top:3px}
#choix-langue .pied{font-size:9.5px;color:#5b5b6e;line-height:1.7;margin-top:14px}

/* Terminal de bord de la carte (easter egg DEVNET).
   Replie : un onglet vertical colle a gauche, la carte reste entiere.
   Deploye : un panneau de 214px. Le contenu vit dans un enfant de largeur
   fixe : sans ca il se remettait en page pendant l'animation et donnait
   l'impression de s'ouvrir plus grand avant de se retracter. */
/* Ancre a la fenetre, pas au contenu : la carte defile, le terminal reste.
   En absolu dans #map-scroll il disparaissait des qu'on descendait, et on ne
   le trouvait qu'en remontant tout en haut. Centre verticalement, colle a
   gauche : toujours sous le pouce, jamais sur la carte. */
#terminal-carte{position:fixed;left:0;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  z-index:45;display:flex;align-items:stretch;
  font-family:ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;pointer-events:none}
#terminal-carte.hidden{display:none}
#term-onglet{pointer-events:auto;flex:none;width:24px;padding:13px 0;cursor:pointer;
  border:1px solid rgba(20,241,149,.45);border-left:none;border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(24,10,48,.95),rgba(4,16,12,.95));
  color:#14F195;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  box-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(153,69,255,.28);transition:box-shadow .2s}
#term-onglet .pt{writing-mode:vertical-rl;text-orientation:mixed;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:2.5px;
  font-weight:700;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#9945FF,#14F195);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
#terminal-carte.ouvert #term-onglet{border-radius:0;box-shadow:0 0 22px rgba(20,241,149,.35)}
/* Seule la largeur s'anime ; la boite interieure garde toujours ses 214px. */
#term-corps{pointer-events:auto;width:0;overflow:hidden;transition:width .24s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.3,1);
  border-radius:0 13px 13px 0}
#terminal-carte.ouvert #term-corps{width:214px}
#term-int{width:214px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:12px 13px;
  max-height:calc(100dvh - 190px);overflow-y:auto;
  border:1px solid rgba(153,69,255,.4);border-left:none;border-radius:0 13px 13px 0;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(20,8,42,.96),rgba(4,14,11,.97));
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 26px rgba(153,69,255,.14)}
#term-int .tl{font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:9px;font-weight:700;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#9945FF,#14F195);-webkit-background-clip:text;
  background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
#term-int .li{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;font-size:9px;line-height:2;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(153,69,255,.13)}
#term-int .li b{color:#7d7595;font-weight:500}
#term-int .li span{color:#d7e3dd;text-align:right;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
#term-int .nd{font-size:8.5px;color:#14F195;margin:11px 0 5px;letter-spacing:2px;font-weight:700}
#term-int .inc{color:#5f5a72;font-style:italic}
#term-int .act{margin-top:11px;padding:7px 9px;border-radius:9px;font-size:8.5px;line-height:1.6;
  color:#c4b5fd;background:rgba(153,69,255,.14);border:1px solid rgba(153,69,255,.34)}

#voile-rotation{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;display:none;
  flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:18px;padding:28px;
  background:rgba(4,3,10,.97);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);text-align:center}
#voile-rotation.on{display:flex}
#voile-rotation .tel{width:58px;height:92px;border-radius:11px;border:2.5px solid #c4b5fd;
  position:relative;animation:pivote 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
#voile-rotation .tel::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:6px;transform:translateX(-50%);
  width:18px;height:2.5px;border-radius:2px;background:#c4b5fd}
@keyframes pivote{0%,18%{transform:rotate(-90deg)}55%,100%{transform:rotate(0deg)}}
#voile-rotation b{font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#c4b5fd}
#voile-rotation span{font-size:11.5px;color:#8b8b9e;line-height:1.65;max-width:280px}

/* ===== Accueil ===== */
.hero{position:relative;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:14px;
  border:1px solid rgba(153,69,255,.3);
  background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(46,20,84,.55),rgba(10,8,22,.75))}
.hero .voile{position:absolute;inset:0;
  background:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 82% 8%,rgba(20,241,149,.16),transparent 55%)}
.hero .dedans{position:relative;padding:16px 17px}
.hero .marque{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;margin-bottom:15px}
.hero .pastille{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:14px;flex:none;display:flex;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:15px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#9945FF,#14F195);color:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(153,69,255,.5)}
.hero h1{font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.6px;
  text-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(153,69,255,.75);line-height:1.15}
.hero .ver{font-size:8.5px;color:#7c7a8c;letter-spacing:1.6px;margin-top:2px}

.soldes{display:flex;gap:10px}
.solde{flex:1;border-radius:15px;padding:11px 13px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.32);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
.solde u{display:block;font-size:8.5px;color:#6b7280;text-decoration:none;letter-spacing:1.3px}
.solde b{display:block;font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif;font-size:15px;margin-top:3px;font-weight:800}
.soldes .solde{padding:10px 9px}
.solde u{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}

/* Tuiles de navigation */
.tuile{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:7px;
  padding:14px 14px 13px;border-radius:17px;text-align:left;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);border:1px solid rgba(153,69,255,.2)}
.tuile .rond{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:11px;display:flex;align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;background:rgba(153,69,255,.16)}
.tuile .rond img{width:20px;height:20px;object-fit:contain}
.tuile b{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.3px}
.tuile small{font-size:9.5px;color:#8b8b9e;line-height:1.4}
.tuile:active{transform:scale(.975)}
.tuile.large{flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:13px}
.tuile.vedette{border-color:rgba(20,241,149,.45);
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(20,241,149,.13),rgba(153,69,255,.1))}
.tuile.vedette .rond{background:rgba(20,241,149,.2)}
.tuile.danger{border-color:rgba(248,113,113,.4)}
.tuile.danger .rond{background:rgba(248,113,113,.16)}

/* ===== Arena : cartes de mode ===== */
.mode-carte{position:relative;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:13px;
  border:1px solid rgba(153,69,255,.28);background:rgba(255,255,255,.035)}
.mode-carte .bandeau{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:15px 16px 12px}
.mode-carte .rond{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:14px;flex:none;display:flex;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(153,69,255,.18)}
.mode-carte .rond img{width:26px;height:26px;object-fit:contain}
.mode-carte .nom{font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1.2px}
.mode-carte .sous{font-size:10.5px;color:#9ca3af;margin-top:3px;line-height:1.5}
.mode-carte .stats{display:flex;gap:8px;padding:0 16px 13px}
.mode-carte .stat{flex:1;text-align:center;padding:8px 4px;border-radius:11px;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.3);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.mode-carte .stat u{display:block;font-size:8.5px;color:#6b7280;text-decoration:none;letter-spacing:.8px}
.mode-carte .stat b{display:block;font-size:13px;margin-top:2px}
.mode-carte .action{padding:0 16px 16px}
.mode-carte.coop{border-color:rgba(20,241,149,.35)}
.mode-carte.coop .rond{background:rgba(20,241,149,.14)}

/* ===== Reglages : une carte par option ===== */
.opt{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;padding:14px 15px;border-radius:16px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);border:1px solid rgba(153,69,255,.18);margin-bottom:10px}
.opt .pict{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:12px;flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;background:rgba(153,69,255,.16)}
.opt .pict img{width:21px;height:21px;object-fit:contain}
.opt .txt{flex:1;min-width:0}
.opt .txt b{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.2px}
.opt .txt small{display:block;font-size:10px;color:#8b8b9e;margin-top:2px;line-height:1.45}
.opt.colonne{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:11px}
.opt.colonne .haut{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px}

/* ===== Zone danger ===== */
.danger-carte{border-radius:16px;border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.3);
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(40,10,14,.55),rgba(24,8,12,.35));padding:15px;margin-bottom:10px}
.danger-carte .t{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin-bottom:6px}
.danger-carte .t b{font-size:13px}
.danger-carte p{font-size:10.5px;color:#9ca3af;line-height:1.55;margin-bottom:11px}

/* ===== Selecteur de carte ===== */

/* ===== Regles : sections depliables ===== */
.regle{border:1px solid rgba(153,69,255,.22);border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:9px;overflow:hidden;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);transition:border-color .2s}
.regle.ouvert{border-color:rgba(20,241,149,.45);background:rgba(20,241,149,.05)}
.regle>button{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:13px 14px;text-align:left;
  background:none;border:0;color:#fff}
.regle .puce{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px;flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;font-size:15px;background:rgba(153,69,255,.18)}
.regle .titre{flex:1;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.3px}
.regle .chev{font-size:11px;color:#9ca3af;transition:transform .25s}
.regle.ouvert .chev{transform:rotate(90deg);color:#14F195}
.regle .corps{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .3s ease}
.regle.ouvert .corps{max-height:640px}
.regle .corps>div{padding:0 14px 14px 54px;font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.75;color:#c9c6d6}
.regle .corps b{color:#fff}
.modal.show{display:flex}
.modal.cf{z-index:400}
.node{transition:all .2s}
.node.available{border-color:rgba(20,241,149,.5)}
.node.completed{border-color:rgba(153,69,255,.4);opacity:.85}
.node.locked{opacity:.4;pointer-events:none}
/* --- Reglages : toggles, segments, zone danger --- */
.tgl{width:46px;height:26px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border:1px solid rgba(153,69,255,.3);position:relative;transition:background .2s;flex:none;cursor:pointer}
.tgl.on{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#9945FF,#14F195);border-color:rgba(20,241,149,.6)}
.tgl>i{position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;transition:transform .2s;display:block}
.tgl.on>i{transform:translateX(20px)}
.seg{display:flex;gap:6px}
.seg>button{flex:1;padding:7px 0;border-radius:10px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(153,69,255,.22);color:#9ca3af}
.seg>button.on{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(153,69,255,.5),rgba(20,241,149,.4));color:#fff;border-color:rgba(20,241,149,.6)}
.danger{border:1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.35);background:rgba(30,8,8,.6)}
.btn-warn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f59e0b,#f97316)}
.btn-danger{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ef4444,#b91c1c)}
.btn-dark{background:rgba(10,10,16,.95);border:1px solid #ef4444;color:#fca5a5}
.btn-warn:active,.btn-danger:active,.btn-dark:active{transform:scale(.96)}
/* --- Fonds d'ecran (v3.9) : embarques en base64, aucun fichier externe requis.
   Overlay violet unifiant sur l'UI, jamais sur le gameplay. --- */
.screen{position:relative;background:none}
.screen::before{content:'';position:fixed;top:0;left:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;
  width:100vw;height:100vh;height:100lvh;            /* lvh : insensible a la barre d'URL mobile */
  background-image:var(--fond,none);background-size:cover;background-position:center center;
  background-repeat:no-repeat;
  filter:saturate(1.22) brightness(1.05);}
.screen::after{content:'';position:fixed;top:0;left:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;
  width:100vw;height:100vh;height:100lvh;
  background:rgba(20,10,40,.30);}
.screen:not(.game)>*{position:relative;z-index:1}
/* En jeu, le HUD garde son positionnement absolu : on remonte juste sa couche */
.screen.game>.absolute{z-index:20}
.screen.game::before,.screen.game::after{display:none}   /* le jeu garde son propre decor */

#s-map     {--fond:none}
